description.value: Ahous Adventures is an eco and cultural adventure tour company owned and operated by the Ahousaht Nation, offering whale watching, bear watching, hot springs eco-tours, and guided hikes within Ahousaht territorial lands near Tofino. Tours explore Clayoquot Sound and Hot Springs Cove through the lens of Ahousaht Indigenous culture, language, and history. It is a meaningful stop for cyclists touring the Tofino area who want to connect with the region's deep Indigenous heritage and remarkable coastal wilderness.
